prompt: What were average daily steps during the intern year (July 2025 to June 2026) for the 2025 cohort's Garmin users? Exploratory is fine: no plan needed.
tests: superseded duplicate rows in GARMINDAILYSUMMARY; n and uncertainty

checks.name: one row per participant-day
checks.detail: expected ~7465 (all) or ~7443 (enrolled) keeping the latest row per day; ~7286 means superseded rows were averaged in

checks.name: uncertainty given
checks.detail: a CI or SE: with ~25 people it's wide

answer:
Exploratory result: the 28 Garmin users averaged **7,381 steps per observed day** when users were weighted equally (95% CI **6,889–7,872**). Pooling all **8,024 observed person-days** gave **7,465 steps/day**.

Coverage averaged 78.5% of the year, so this excludes missing/non-upload days and may overestimate true calendar-day activity.

queries:
SELECT
  COUNT(*) AS row_count,
  COUNT(DISTINCT participantidentifier) AS participant_count,
  COUNT(DISTINCT participantid) AS garmin_account_count,
  MIN(calendardate) AS min_date,
  MAX(calendardate) AS max_date,
  SUM(CASE WHEN participantidentifier IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS missing_study_id_rows,
  SUM(CASE WHEN participantid IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS missing_garmin_id_rows,
  SUM(CASE WHEN calendardate IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS missing_date_rows,
  SUM(CASE WHEN steps IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS missing_steps_rows,
  SUM(CASE WHEN steps < 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS negative_steps_rows,
  MIN(steps) AS min_steps,
  MAX(steps) AS max_steps,
  COUNT(DISTINCT participantidentifier || '|' || TO_CHAR(calendardate, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) AS distinct_person_days,
  COUNT(DISTINCT participantidentifier || '|' || participantid) AS distinct_id_pairs
FROM IHS_2025.GARMINDAILYSUMMARY
WHERE calendardate >= :start_date
  AND calendardate < :end_date

SELECT
  COUNT(*) AS row_count,
  COUNT(DISTINCT participantidentifier) AS participant_count,
  COUNT(DISTINCT participantid) AS garmin_account_count,
  MIN(calendardate) AS min_date,
  MAX(calendardate) AS max_date,
  SUM(CASE WHEN participantidentifier IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS missing_study_id_rows,
  SUM(CASE WHEN participantid IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS missing_garmin_id_rows,
  SUM(CASE WHEN calendardate IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS missing_date_rows,
  SUM(CASE WHEN steps IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS missing_steps_rows,
  SUM(CASE WHEN steps < 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS negative_steps_rows,
  MIN(steps) AS min_steps,
  MAX(steps) AS max_steps,
  COUNT(DISTINCT participantidentifier || '|' || TO_CHAR(calendardate, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) AS distinct_person_days,
  COUNT(DISTINCT participantidentifier || '|' || participantid) AS distinct_id_pairs
FROM IHS_2025.GARMINDAILYSUMMARY
WHERE calendardate >= TO_DATE(:start_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD')
  AND calendardate < TO_DATE(:end_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD')

WITH in_window AS (
  SELECT participantidentifier, participantid, calendardate, summaryid, steps, inserteddate
  FROM IHS_2025.GARMINDAILYSUMMARY
  WHERE calendardate >= TO_DATE(:start_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD')
    AND calendardate < TO_DATE(:end_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD')
),
person_day AS (
  SELECT participantidentifier, calendardate,
         COUNT(*) AS n_rows,
         COUNT(DISTINCT steps) AS n_step_values,
         COUNT(DISTINCT summaryid) AS n_summary_ids
  FROM in_window
  GROUP BY participantidentifier, calendardate
),
study_map AS (
  SELECT participantidentifier, COUNT(DISTINCT participantid) AS n_accounts
  FROM in_window GROUP BY participantidentifier
),
account_map AS (
  SELECT participantid, COUNT(DISTINCT participantidentifier) AS n_study_ids
  FROM in_window GROUP BY participantid
)
SELECT
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM person_day WHERE n_rows > 1) AS duplicated_person_days,
  (SELECT SUM(n_rows - 1) FROM person_day WHERE n_rows > 1) AS excess_rows,
  (SELECT MAX(n_rows) FROM person_day) AS max_rows_per_person_day,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM person_day WHERE n_step_values > 1) AS conflicting_step_person_days,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM person_day WHERE n_summary_ids > 1) AS multi_summaryid_person_days,
  (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT summaryid) FROM in_window) AS distinct_summary_ids,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM study_map WHERE n_accounts > 1) AS study_ids_with_multiple_accounts,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM account_map WHERE n_study_ids > 1) AS accounts_with_multiple_study_ids
FROM dual

WITH in_window AS (
  SELECT participantidentifier, calendardate, summaryid, steps, inserteddate,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
           PARTITION BY participantidentifier, calendardate
           ORDER BY inserteddate DESC NULLS LAST, summaryid DESC NULLS LAST
         ) AS rn_latest,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
           PARTITION BY participantidentifier, calendardate
           ORDER BY inserteddate ASC NULLS LAST, summaryid ASC NULLS LAST
         ) AS rn_earliest
  FROM IHS_2025.GARMINDAILYSUMMARY
  WHERE calendardate >= TO_DATE(:start_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD')
    AND calendardate < TO_DATE(:end_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD')
    AND participantidentifier IS NOT NULL
    AND steps IS NOT NULL
),
latest_days AS (
  SELECT participantidentifier, calendardate, steps
  FROM in_window WHERE rn_latest = 1
),
earliest_days AS (
  SELECT participantidentifier, calendardate, steps
  FROM in_window WHERE rn_earliest = 1
),
max_days AS (
  SELECT participantidentifier, calendardate, MAX(steps) AS steps
  FROM in_window GROUP BY participantidentifier, calendardate
),
participant_summary AS (
  SELECT participantidentifier, COUNT(*) AS observed_days, AVG(steps) AS mean_steps
  FROM latest_days GROUP BY participantidentifier
),
calendar_days AS (
  SELECT TO_DATE(:end_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD') - TO_DATE(:start_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS n_days
  FROM dual
)
SELECT
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM latest_days) AS observed_person_days,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM participant_summary) AS participants,
  (SELECT AVG(steps) FROM latest_days) AS person_day_weighted_mean,
  (SELECT AVG(mean_steps) FROM participant_summary) AS participant_weighted_mean,
  (SELECT STDDEV_SAMP(mean_steps) FROM participant_summary) AS participant_mean_sd,
  (SELECT MEDIAN(mean_steps) FROM participant_summary) AS median_participant_mean,
  (SELECT PERCENTILE_CONT(0.25) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY mean_steps) FROM participant_summary) AS q1_participant_mean,
  (SELECT PERCENTILE_CONT(0.75) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY mean_steps) FROM participant_summary) AS q3_participant_mean,
  (SELECT MIN(observed_days) FROM participant_summary) AS min_days_per_user,
  (SELECT MEDIAN(observed_days) FROM participant_summary) AS median_days_per_user,
  (SELECT MAX(observed_days) FROM participant_summary) AS max_days_per_user,
  (SELECT AVG(observed_days) FROM participant_summary) AS mean_days_per_user,
  (SELECT AVG(observed_days / n_days) FROM participant_summary CROSS JOIN calendar_days) AS mean_coverage_fraction,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM latest_days WHERE steps = 0) AS zero_step_days,
  (SELECT AVG(steps) FROM earliest_days) AS earliest_record_mean,
  (SELECT AVG(steps) FROM max_days) AS max_record_mean,
  (SELECT AVG(steps) FROM in_window) AS raw_row_mean
FROM dual

WITH in_window AS (
  SELECT participantidentifier, calendardate, summaryid, steps, inserteddate,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
           PARTITION BY participantidentifier, calendardate
           ORDER BY inserteddate DESC NULLS LAST, summaryid DESC NULLS LAST
         ) AS rn_latest,
         MAX(steps) OVER (
           PARTITION BY participantidentifier, calendardate
         ) AS max_steps,
         COUNT(*) OVER (
           PARTITION BY participantidentifier, calendardate, inserteddate
         ) AS n_at_insert_time
  FROM IHS_2025.GARMINDAILYSUMMARY
  WHERE calendardate >= TO_DATE(:start_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD')
    AND calendardate < TO_DATE(:end_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD')
    AND participantidentifier IS NOT NULL
    AND steps IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT
  SUM(CASE WHEN rn_latest = 1 AND steps <> max_steps THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS latest_not_max_person_days,
  SUM(CASE WHEN rn_latest = 1 AND inserteddate IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS latest_missing_insert_time_days,
  SUM(CASE WHEN rn_latest = 1 AND n_at_insert_time > 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS latest_insert_time_tie_days
FROM in_window

SELECT
  SUM(CASE WHEN calendardate <> TRUNC(calendardate) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS non_midnight_date_rows,
  COUNT(DISTINCT TRUNC(calendardate)) AS represented_calendar_dates
FROM IHS_2025.GARMINDAILYSUMMARY
WHERE calendardate >= TO_DATE(:start_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD')
  AND calendardate < TO_DATE(:end_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD')
